what: G1's shared domain: the questions both references evaluate as the same prompt, token ids, selectors and label groups. It replaces the blanket hf-diff- prefix rule (C16): inclusion is explicit, every exclusion names a kind and the exact refusal or differing fields it expects, and compare.py checks both.

notes.hf-diff-packing: Included from observations/ at set_size = 1 (each question alone), never packed/.
notes.hf-diff-duplicate-keys: Both references keep the last value at the first position, so they evaluate the same sequence: reference-to-reference numeric evidence. xybrid itself refuses the request at parse (duplicate_key); that stays a G0 requirement.
notes.hf-choice-one: Its question has one group, so its AGE is 0 by construction: counted, never cited as evidence.
